hook: *844* drunk drivers caught in Hyderabad in a week. *707* were on two-wheelers
tldr: Hyderabad traffic police caught 481 drunk drivers on Oct 23–24; Malkajgiri police caught 363 from Oct 18–24. 707 of the 844 were on two-wheelers. Cause a death while drunk and you can be charged with culpable homicide under BNS Section 105.

beats.what: Two special drives over the past week netted 844 drunk drivers across Hyderabad and Malkajgiri.
beats.why: Weekend enforcement is being stepped up. Courts disposed of 178 cases in Malkajgiri in the same week: 162 fined, 16 fined plus community service.
beats.care: Weekend checks are everywhere now. Book a cab; a fatal crash while drunk can now be treated like culpable homicide.

cards.caption: of 844 were on two-wheelers
cards.body: Hyderabad: 397 two-wheelers of 481. Malkajgiri: 310 of 363, all men.
